With langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite 3.1.3 installed from the existing optional extra, the suite is 252 passed with 0 skipped, and both resume tests are named PASSED in $RUN/pytest-durable.log. notes: No code changed in this pass. Evidence: $RUN=/home/user/credit-memo-agent/.bridgie/runs/statement-review/hardener-08 (pytest-durable.log, pytest-base-env.log, probe/rollback.log, venv/ with the durable extra, base/ = git archive of f74eaac). Gaps for the owner: (1) CI/runner: the verify runner's environment lacks the 'durable' extra, so the 5 SQLite tests always skip there. Install `.[durable]` in the runner or the old-checkpoint claim stays unproven by the runner. (2) Rollback limit for later tasks: the old enum rejects any persisted Transaction whose category is a new value (cash_deposit and the rest). T02 never assigns them, so rollback is clean now. Once the v2 categoriser (C1) lands, a pending review whose checkpoint holds v2 categories cannot be resumed by an older package. The design's rollback (CMA_RULESET=v1) covers new runs, not pending checkpoints, so this needs a decision or a documented repair before v2 becomes the default. (3) Docs: the repo has no CHANGELOG. The release-note line ('M2 now counts cash paid in; new money-in categories') and the README wording for M16 belong to the task that renames M16 and turns v2 on, not T02.
